tools.title: Brevo
tools.summary: Email, SMS and WhatsApp marketing with a CRM.

servers.name: Brevo MCP server
servers.capabilities: Contacts, lists, email/SMS/WhatsApp campaigns, CRM deals, templates, analytics and account administration (27 modules).

tools.notes: Create an API key with the MCP option enabled; each module also has its own endpoint (for example /v1/brevo_contacts/mcp).

tools.title: Mailchimp

servers.name: Mailchimp Transactional (Mandrill) MCP
servers.capabilities: Check account status, build templates, call and describe Transactional API endpoints, diagnose failed sends.

access.consent: Use a Mailchimp Transactional (Mandrill) API key

tools.notes: The documented server covers Mailchimp Transactional only. Marketing campaigns are reachable through Mailchimp's Claude and ChatGPT connectors, whose endpoint is not published in Mailchimp's docs; a docs-only server is at https://mailchimp.com/developer/_mcp/server.

tools.title: WordPress
tools.summary: Open-source CMS for websites and blogs.

servers.name: WordPress.com MCP
servers.capabilities: Work with every WordPress.com or Jetpack-connected site on the account.

servers.name: WordPress MCP Adapter (self-hosted, via remote proxy)
servers.capabilities: Exposes WordPress Abilities as MCP tools from a self-hosted site with the mcp-adapter plugin.

tools.notes: WordPress.com MCP needs a paid plan (free sites and Jetpack sites without plan until 30 Nov 2026) and must be enabled in account settings. Self-hosted sites install the mcp-adapter plugin (endpoint /wp-json/mcp/mcp-adapter-default-server, set as WP_API_URL) and use an Application Password; abilities are private by default. Automattic/wordpress-mcp is deprecated.
